title: Study of the antidiabetic mechanism of berberine compound on FOXO1 transcription factor through molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations.
authors: Maksum, Iman Permana; Rustaman, Rustaman; Deawati, Yusi; Rukayadi, Yaya; Utami, Ayudiah Rizki; Nafisa, Zahra Khira
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟研究小檗碱化合物与FOXO1转录因子的结合稳定性，虽涉及TF蛋白和物理模拟方法，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与课题核心体系偏离。
abstract: CONTEXT: Diabetes mellitus (DM) is a metabolic disorder disease that causes hyperglycemia conditions and associated with various chronic complications leading to mortality. Due to high toxicity of conventional diabetic drugs, the exploration of natural compounds as alternative diabetes treatments has been widely carried out. Previous in silico studies have highlighted berberine, a natural compound, as a promising alternative in antidiabetic therapy, potentially acting through various pathways, including the inhibition of the FOXO1 transcription factor in the gluconeogenesis pathway. However, the specific mechanism by which berberine interacts with FOXO1 remains unclear, and research in this area is relatively limited. Therefore, this study aims to determine the stability of berberine structure with FOXO1 based on RMSD, RMSF, binding energy, and trajectory analysis to determine the potential of berberine to inhibit the gluconeogenesis pathway. This research was conducted by in silico method with molecular docking using AutoDock4.2 and molecular dynamics study using Amber20, then visualized by VMD. METHODS: Docking between ligand and FOXO1 receptor was carried out with Autodock4.2. For molecular dynamics simulations, the force fields of DNA.OL15, protein.ff14SB, gaff2, and tip3p were used.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病（DM）是一种代谢紊乱疾病，导致高血糖状态，并与多种慢性并发症相关，进而引起死亡。由于传统糖尿病药物具有高毒性，探索天然化合物作为替代性糖尿病治疗手段已被广泛开展。先前的计算机模拟研究已强调，天然化合物小檗碱（berberine）作为抗糖尿病治疗中一种有前景的替代选择，可能通过多种途径发挥作用，包括抑制糖异生途径中的FOXO1转录因子。然而，小檗碱与FOXO1相互作用的具体机制仍不清楚，且该领域的研究相对有限。因此，本研究旨在基于RMSD、RMSF、结合能和轨迹分析，确定小檗碱与FOXO1结构的稳定性，以评估小檗碱抑制糖异生途径的潜力。本研究采用计算机模拟方法，通过AutoDock4.2进行分子对接，使用Amber20进行分子动力学研究，并通过VMD进行可视化。方法：使用Autodock4.2进行配体与FOXO1受体之间的对接。对于分子动力学模拟，使用了DNA.OL15、protein.ff14SB、gaff2和tip3p力场。
